translations.web: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
translations.bsb: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
translations.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.
translations.asv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
